algorithm: Call actual004DDD60 first. If its full EAX is zero, return8 without changing dirty state or consuming any direction flags.
Read signed DWORD cursor X at E38DC4. Store DWORD E38DCC=0. X<=0 sets west and dirty1; X>=wrapped(DWORD screen width E38DB8-1) sets east and dirty1.
Read signed DWORD cursor Y at E38DC0. Y<=0 sets north and dirty1; Y>=wrapped(DWORD screen height E38DB4-1) sets south and dirty1. Native code has no extra out-of-window rejection.
Overlay nonzero full DWORD keyboard flags in native read order: E92E30 west,E92E2C east,E92E38 north,E92E34 south. Each active flag sets dirty1.
Clear four full DWORD flags in order E92E2C,E92E30,E92E34,E92E38 before selecting a direction.
Resolve west+north=7,west+south=5,east+north=1,east+south=3,west=6,north=0,south=4,east=2,otherwise8. This order gives west/north priority when opposite flags coexist; it does not cancel them.
